Build Your Cabinet Plan
Straight from the source

Factory-direct.
Clear responsibilities.

Amber Leaf manufactures and supplies complete cabinetry, rather than only replacement cabinet fronts. Your plan brings cabinet sizes, visible finishes and interior storage into one specification conversation.

Customer configuration→Specification review→Final quote→Customer approval→Manufacturing→Delivery / installation

Manufacturing & quality

Ask which cabinet components are made directly, how the proposed construction is checked and which finish options can be produced. Factory certifications and inspection procedures have not been supplied.

Measurements & approvals

Agree on who measures the site and approves the cabinet schedule. Review appliance clearances, plumbing and nonstandard dimensions before manufacturing.

Delivery & installation

Confirm assembly state, delivery access, packaging and who installs. Shipping timelines and installation availability are project-specific.

Warranty & after-sales

Request written warranty coverage, exclusions, maintenance instructions and support contacts for the exact selected cabinetry. No warranty terms are assumed here.
